title: Bidder debrief v1 (plaintext inside the ECIES envelope)
description: Encrypted to the bidder's debrief public key (registered with the bid). Lets a bidder check their own score end to end: recompute their total, check the evidence quotes, hash the raw model request/response bytes and match them to the signed hashes in the public bundle. The committee report uses the same structure for every bid plus the decrypted proposals.
